Put app images here.

Current expected files:
- `birthday-hero.png` for the main hero background.
- `gallery-1.jpg`, `gallery-2.jpg`, and `gallery-3.jpg` for the default photo gallery.
- `optimized/birthday-hero.jpg` and `optimized/gallery-1.jpg` through `optimized/gallery-9.jpg` are the compressed files used by the app.

You can replace these filenames with your own files, or update the paths in `src/main.jsx`.
